QuestInfo.name: [8th Anniversary] Spiegelmann's Number Cruncher!
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann's got some number game up his sleeve... Sounds fun!
QuestInfo.1: If the sum of the numbers from the mysterious box matches up with Spiegelmann's number, you win! If it doesn't match you, you get nothing! Are you ready for the challenge?!\n\n#e#b(3 Dice will be consumed if you forfeit the quest.)#k#n
